texts.li: [soldier,winter] A traveler in an old army greatcoat came through the snow asking for {A_nameDef}. It's {X_nameDef}, who shared a tent with {A_objective} through the worst winter of the war. {X_nameDef} has nowhere to spend this one, and asks to stay.

[outlaw,lowtech] Word came up from the road that someone was asking for {A_nameDef} by an old nickname, one {A_nameDef} hasn't answered to in years. It's {X_nameDef}, who ran the roads with {A_objective} years ago. {X_nameDef} says {X_pronoun} is honest now, and would like a place here.

[soldier,partner] {A_nameDef}'s partner has heard a great deal about {X_nameDef} over the years, not all of it flattering. Now {X_nameDef}, who served beside {A_nameDef} in the old days, is on the road below the colony with a pack and a hopeful look, asking to stay.

lines.li: [soldier] {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} stayed up late, drinking to the names of the people who didn't come home. {X_nameDef} lives here now.

texts.li: [winter] A figure came out of the snow at dusk and asked for {A_nameDef}. It's {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, who heard a rumor last autumn that {A_nameDef} was alive and has been walking ever since. {X_nameDef} asks to stay.

[farmer] After the farm was lost, the family scattered, and {X_nameDef} has been asking for {A_nameDef} in every market town since. Now {A_nameDef}'s {RELATION} has found {A_objective} at last, and would like to stay.

[lowtech] Sweethearts once, in another village, before everything went wrong. Now {X_nameDef} is on the road below the colony with a bundle on {X_possessive} back, asking for {A_nameDef}, with no one else to go to.

[!lowtech,partner] {X_nameDef} is outside the colony, asking for {A_nameDef}. They lived together once, before the colony, and parted badly. {A_nameDef}'s partner was in the room when the name was said, and hasn't said a word since.

[quit,winter] {X_nameDef}, who walked out on the colony, has come back through the snow, thin and cold and not proud anymore, and is waiting on the road below. {X_nameDef} asks to come home. {A_nameDef} brought the request in.

[banished,winter] {X_nameDef}, who was sent away, has spent the winter somewhere hard and come back to the colony's road asking for one more chance. {A_nameDef} has put a blanket aside already, before anyone has decided anything.

[trader,!lowtech] A man in a good suit and bad boots has come up the road with a ledger. {A_nameDef} owes his employers {COUNT} silver from a deal that went sour years ago, and the interest, he says, has been very patient.

[outlaw,lowtech] A one-eyed stranger on the road has been asking for {A_nameDef}, and {A_nameDef} went pale when told what the stranger looks like. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver to the band {A_pronoun} used to ride with, and they've sent someone to collect.
[farmer] The old farmer {A_nameDef} worked for as a youngster has died, and left {A_nameDef} a share of what the farm was worth. It has been sent on, with a note in a neighbor's hand.
[artisan] {A_nameDef}'s old master has died and left {A_objective} a chest from the workshop. It has come a long way, with a short note in the master's hand: "For the one who listened."
[trader] An old trading partner of {A_nameDef}'s has died, and the will names {A_objective}. The bequest came with a list of debts the partner swore were all paid.

[Cooking] A letter has come for {A_nameDef} from the cook who taught {A_objective}, years ago, to make bread. It's mostly a recipe, with corrections, and a line at the bottom saying {A_nameDef} never measured the salt.
[Medicine] {A_nameDef}'s old teacher of medicine has sent a letter, much traveled, asking whether {A_nameDef} still boils {A_possessive} needles. There are three pages of new remedies after that.

[Construction] A note has reached {A_nameDef} from the builder who taught {A_objective} the trade. It says only: "Heard you're building walls now. Mind the corners." {A_nameDef} has read it many times.
[Shooting] {A_nameDef}'s old shooting instructor has sent word, by way of a passing hunter: still alive, still sure {A_nameDef} flinches, and proud anyway.
[scholar] The library where {A_nameDef} studied came through the troubles, a letter says, and someone there still keeps {A_possessive} old notes on a shelf.
[healer] The clinic {A_nameDef} once worked in has reopened, and the people there still speak of {A_objective}.
[artisan] {A_nameDef} heard from a traveler that the workshop {A_pronoun} trained in is busier than ever, and the old master still uses {A_nameDef}'s work to show apprentices how it's done.
[trader] News came with a caravan: the trading house {A_nameDef} worked for has paid off every debt it had, and {A_nameDef}'s name is on the list of people it thanks.
[farmer] The farm country {A_nameDef} came from has gone back to scrub, a traveler says. The families left one by one after the bad years, and the last of them went this spring.
[lowtech,winter] News came with the winter's last traveler. The town {A_nameDef} grew up in was emptied by sickness. Its houses stand open to the weather now.
